title: Animal-Assisted Human Services (AAHS) competencies, credentials, and training: A Powerful Trio
abstract: Abstract Canada presently lacks comprehensive data on skills, credentials, and training requirements within its Animal-Assisted Human Services (AAHS) sector. Consequently, this commentary emphasizes how this intricate and fragmented field could be recognized and exemplary industry sector grounded in transparency, accountability, and professionalism. AAHS encompasses Assistance/Service Animals, Animal-Assisted Activities (AAA), Animal-Assisted Learning (AAL), and Animal-Assisted Therapy (AAT). Despite its rapid growth and nationwide presence, the sector remains largely unregulated, difficult to navigate, and research. Without a unified national framework and the infrastructure needed to support and guide practices and encourage innovation, the AAHS sector remains compromised. Nevertheless, persistent demand and need for AAHS accentuate the significance of developing a coordinated strategy that safeguards the well-being of consumers and end users, the welfare of Human Services Assistance Animals (HSAAs), and augments public confidence. Ongoing engagement with consumers, end users, service providers, and other stakeholders is vital to preventing exploitation and ensuring services are ethical and evidence-based. The industry’s voluntary National Standard of Canada (NSC) was co-established in good faith to uphold the credibility of the AAHS sector and to support Animal-Assisted Human Services Providers (AAHSP) and Animal-Assisted Services Professionals (AASP), enabling them to focus on the needs and well-being of consumers, end-users, and the welfare of Human Services Assistance Animals (HSAA) while preserving the credibility of both the service providers and the industry. Moreover, this commentary features the numerous benefits of acknowledging and investing in Canada’s AAHS labour market, including promising careers, recognition through existing and evolving channels, and the creation of new employment opportunities that align with diverse educational and professional aspirations nationwide.
